import sys
import re

totalWordsInBraces = 0
maxWordLength = 0

def countWords(s):
    s = s.replace("_", " ")
    s = s.strip()
    s = re.sub(" +", " ", s)
    tokens = s.split(" ")
    if len(tokens) == 1 and tokens[0] == "":
        return 0
    return len(tokens)

def main():
    input_data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    n = int(input_data[0])
    s = input_data[1]
    brace_positions = [-1]
    for i, ch in enumerate(s):
        if ch == '(' or ch == ')':
            brace_positions.append(i)
    i = 1
    totalCount = 0
    maxWordLen = 0
    outsideText = ""
    while i < len(brace_positions) - 1:
        startIdx = brace_positions[i]
        endIdx = brace_positions[i + 1]
        insideStr = s[startIdx + 1:endIdx]
        countWordsInBrace = countWords(insideStr)
        global totalWordsInBraces
        totalWordsInBraces += countWordsInBrace
        prev_idx = brace_positions[i - 1]
        outsideText += "_" + s[prev_idx + 1:startIdx]
        i += 2
    outsideText += "_" + s[brace_positions[-1] + 1:]
    outsideText = outsideText.replace("_", " ")
    outsideText = outsideText.strip()
    outsideText = re.sub(" +", " ", outsideText)
    outsideWords = outsideText.split(" ")
    for w in outsideWords:
        if len(w) > maxWordLen:
            maxWordLen = len(w)
    print(f"{maxWordLen} {totalWordsInBraces}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
